d:
Just when things were looking up, Ravi and Jyoti face surprise “villains” — and no, not the movie kind.
Family tensions explode, dreams hang by a thread, and Ravi is forced to choose between love and his OSC exam.
Will he fight for both? Or lose it all trying?
Ye Saali Naukri - Ep 3 is the emotional rollercoaster you didn’t see coming — because real-life dreams come with real drama.
Presented by Dice Media & Civic Studios
A Civic Studios Original Production
Directed by
Kaviraj Singh
